method: Character TF-IDF 3-5 grams; maximum cosine similarity to any Juliet training row
split: First StratifiedGroupKFold fold, n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42
interpretation_note: Cosine similarity is a screening signal, not proof of leakage. High similarity can arise from shared Juliet templates or common syntax. Inspect the highest-scoring pairs before drawing conclusions.
